title: Shortest Common Supersequence
summary: Given two strings str1 and str2, find and return the shortest string that includes both as subsequences.
statement: Given two strings str1 and str2, find and return the shortest string that includes both as subsequences. Multiple valid solutions are acceptable, as long as both str1 and str2 are subsequences of the returned string.
constraints: Both inputs must be subsequences of the result.
Return the lexicographically smallest among shortest valid supersequences.
hints: Memoize the shortest answer for suffix index pairs.
Equal leading characters are shared; otherwise prepend either leading character and choose by length then lexicographic order.
Base cases append the untouched other suffix.
Every common supersequence begins with one permitted leading choice, so the recurrence is exhaustive and optimal.
editorial: Every common supersequence begins with one permitted leading choice, so the recurrence is exhaustive and optimal.

tests.explanation: Cabac contains both inputs and has minimum length five.
Identical strings are already their own shortest supersequence.
